chronological_inner_oof.partition: split the ordered outer-training sessions into five contiguous blocks with sizes differing by at most one; assign any remainder to earlier blocks
chronological_inner_oof.prediction_blocks: for block j in {2,3,4,5}, fit only on blocks before j after removing the chronologically last preceding session as a one-session embargo, then predict block j
chronological_inner_oof.first_block: fit warmup only; it produces no OOF calibration predictions
chronological_inner_oof.identity_rule: each OOF prediction carries outer_fold, inner_block, session, decision_time, exact contract identity, model hash, and feature/target hashes
chronological_inner_oof.final_outer_model: after all inner choices freeze, refit the same architecture on the complete outer-training role; reuse only the frozen OOF-derived calibrators and composer parameters

continuous.finite_sample_quantile: ceil((n+1)*q)/n order-statistic convention, capped at the largest residual
continuous.fit_source: chronological inner OOF predictions and observed training-role labels only

distribution_calibration.binary: isotonic regression on chronological inner OOF predictions
distribution_calibration.discrete_survival: isotonic cumulative-incidence calibration separately at every registered horizon

guardrail_thresholds.method: reuse the FT2-05 guardrail quantile semantics: pandas/numpy linear empirical quantile within market phase, with higher-good q=alpha and lower-good q=1-alpha
guardrail_thresholds.implementation_requirement: FT2-30 must import or factor the canonical FT2-05 quantile helper and prove equivalence on synthetic fixtures; a divergent reimplementation fails
guardrail_thresholds.fallback: globally pooled training-role threshold when a phase has fewer than 8 distinct calibration sessions or 2000 valid contract rows

selection_order: discard settings outside the design trade-rate band
maximize the inner objective in objective_spec.json

design_trade_rate_band_mean_trades_per_s.purpose: broad joint-calibration target that permits abstention and prevents the three conservative layers from independently collapsing or exploding activity

joint_conservatism.no_setting_in_band: joint_calibration_insufficient; do not inspect outer evidence

uncertainty.model_ensemble: three independent seeds with median quantile aggregation
uncertainty.epistemic: 1.4826 times median absolute deviation of seed q50 values
uncertainty.gap_conformal: 0.90 finite-sample split-conformal quantile of absolute predicted-minus-realized pairwise score-gap error
uncertainty.source_transfer: candidate-specific p95 absolute score-gap drift from accepted transfer evidence
uncertainty.activation_without_source_evidence: historical research may run with source_transfer marked unavailable; live or shadow activation fails closed

action_conditioned_gate.name: Protocol101EntryActionConditionedCalibrationGateV1

wait_reliability.prediction: calibrated probability that no exact contract in the governed risk set clears the realized quality screen and realized positive-after-fee rule
wait_reliability.outcome: 1 only when the frozen realized-label composer says WAIT; oracle action is audit-only and never a runtime feature
wait_reliability.binning: 10 equal-frequency bins; merge the smallest adjacent bins deterministically from left to right until every bin has at least 10 observations

selected_contract_regret.realized_regret: maximum realized whole-path quality Q among the exact governed risk set minus realized Q of the selected contract, floored at zero and divided by 2 because Q lies in [-1,1]; normalized regret therefore lies in [0,1]
selected_contract_regret.prediction: training-only calibrated expected regret and 90 percent upper prediction bound conditional on ENTER
selected_contract_regret.normalization: regret_Q / 2; no dollar or equity scale is mixed into this calibration statistic

action_conditioned_gate.before_activation: confidence-controlled composer behavior cannot become an accepted training or runtime candidate
action_conditioned_gate.exit_side_deferred: HOLD/EXIT reliability and floor behavior are defined only in FT2-60 lifecycle contract

hashing.canonical_json: UTF-8 sorted keys compact separators no NaN or Infinity
